source_prompt: Ultra-detailed surreal pharmaceutical research laboratory at twilight, wide cinematic 16:9 composition. Center: a translucent teal glass molecular model of a double-helix drug scaffold floating above a brushed-steel bench, with glowing cyan bond lines and amber atom nodes. Left: a wall-sized holographic dashboard titled "EvidenceGrade AI" in bold white sans-serif, showing a 5-tier grade ladder (A emerald, B teal, C gold, D orange, F crimson) and a line chart labeled "Citation Confidence 2019-2026". Right: a large arched window revealing a rainy neo-Tokyo street with neon kanji signs reflecting on wet asphalt, a red umbrella leaning against the window sill, and a black cat silhouette on the ledge. Foreground: an open leather notebook with handwritten notes "CYP3A4 interaction risk" and a fountain pen, next to a white ceramic coffee cup with a teal lid and a cracked porcelain saucer. Ceiling: brass articulated lamps casting warm pools of light; one lamp has a green glass shade. Background shelves: amber glass reagent bottles labeled Aspirin, Warfarin, Ibuprofen in clean black type, a vintage brass microscope, and a small potted monstera plant with one yellow leaf. Atmosphere: volumetric god-rays through rain-streaked glass, subtle film grain, high dynamic range, teal-and-amber complementary color grade, no logos of real companies, no watermarks, photorealistic mixed with holographic UI.

results.reconstructed_prompt:
A cinematic 3D-rendered scene of a moody, rain-soaked apothecary laboratory at night. In the left foreground, a large glowing holographic glass panel displays "EvidenceGrade AI" in bold white text at the top, with a "5-tier grade" label and five colored rectangular grade bars stacked vertically: A (green), B (teal), C (yellow/gold), D (orange), F (red/crimson). To the right of the bars on the same panel is a line chart titled "Citation Confidence 2019-2026" with a rising cyan line graph, y-axis values 0 to 60, and the text "Citation Confidence 2019-2026" repeated along the bottom axis. The panel has a translucent teal-glass material with glowing edges.

In the center of the frame, a large DNA double helix made of translucent teal glass spheres connected by rods with gold/brass nodes floats above a brushed stainless steel laboratory table, rendered in a glossy molecular-model style.

On the table in the foreground: an open spiral-bound notebook on a brown leather pad with handwritten cursive notes reading "CYP3A4 interaction risk" (other handwriting partially legible), a black fountain pen resting on the page; on the right side of the table a white ceramic coffee cup with a teal lid on a matching saucer with a cracked-glaze pattern.

Background: white shelves mounted on the wall holding amber glass apothecary bottles with labels reading "Aspirin", "Warfarin", "Ibuprofen" in vintage serif typography, plus small vials and jars. A brass microscope sits on the counter below the shelves. A potted monstera plant in a white pot on the right shelf area. Multiple articulated brass pharmacy-style lamps hang from the ceiling — one with a green enamel shade glowing warmly, others with bare warm bulbs, extending on adjustable arms from the upper left and center.

On the right side, a large arched window with black frames looks out onto a rainy cyberpunk city street at night: wet pavement reflecting pink, red, and cyan neon signs with Chinese characters (glowing vertical neon kanji signs in red, pink, and blue), blurred bokeh lights, rain streaks on the glass. A small dark cat silhouette statue perches on the windowsill next to a closed red umbrella leaning against the window frame.

Lighting: warm tungsten glow from the lamps contrasting with cool teal ambient light and colorful neon reflections from outside; volumetric atmosphere, soft haze. Style: hyperdetailed 3D render, octane render quality, cinematic composition, shallow depth of field, photorealistic materials with stylized holographic UI elements, muted teal-and-brass color palette accented by neon pink and green.
